summary.name: ChatDev
summary.one_liner: ChatDev is a research framework in which teams of LLM-driven agents communicate via chat to design, code, and test software.
keywords: language as bridge for llm agents
use_cases: automated software generation from natural language
studying LLM-based design, coding and testing workflows
summary.what_it_does: The paper introduces ChatDev, a chat-powered framework where specialized LLM agents take part in the design, coding, and testing phases of software development. The agents are guided on what to communicate through a chat chain and on how to communicate through communicative dehallucination. The authors report that natural language communication helped with system design, while communicating in programming language helped with debugging. The code and data are stated to be available on GitHub under OpenBMB/ChatDev.
notable: Chat chain guides what agents communicate about
Communicative dehallucination guides how agents communicate
Uses natural language for design and programming language for debugging
Code and data released on GitHub (OpenBMB/ChatDev)
